build_unity_conformer_model: build a UnityConformerModel for direct speech-to-speech translation with Conformer encoder and multitask decoders
build_multitask_decoder: build a multitask decoder with transformer or CTC type for the UnityConformerModel
build_decoder: build a TransformerUnitDecoder or AugTransformerUnitDecoder with stacked embeddings for unit decoding
forward_unity_conformer: run the UnityConformerModel forward pass with source tokens, target tokens, and multitask decoder output
configure_unity_conformer_architecture: configure the unity_conformer architecture base with encoder layers, embed dimensions, and attention heads
